questions.stem: In Question Bank Medium deck, select all characteristics of Dense Regular Connective Tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Compact parallel white collagen fiber bundles
B) Fibroblasts arranged in rows between collagen strands
C) High tensile strength along direction of fiber orientation
D) Forms Tendons connecting muscle to bone
E) Random meshwork of fibers resisting multidirectional stress
answers: A) Compact parallel white collagen fiber bundles
B) Fibroblasts arranged in rows between collagen strands
C) High tensile strength along direction of fiber orientation
D) Forms Tendons connecting muscle to bone
questions.explanation: Dense regular CT contains parallel collagen bundles and row-arranged fibroblasts in tendons.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Medium deck, select all true statements regarding Bone vs Cartilage matrix: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Bone matrix is hard and mineralized with Ossein and Calcium Phosphate
B) Cartilage matrix is solid pliable chondrin with anti-angiogenic factors
C) Bone possesses Haversian canals and rich blood supply
D) Cartilage is avascular and nourished by perichondrial diffusion
E) Both bone and cartilage matrix contain mineralized calcium hydroxyapatite
answers: A) Bone matrix is hard and mineralized with Ossein and Calcium Phosphate
B) Cartilage matrix is solid pliable chondrin with anti-angiogenic factors
C) Bone possesses Haversian canals and rich blood supply
D) Cartilage is avascular and nourished by perichondrial diffusion
questions.explanation: Bone has mineralized ossein and Haversian canals; cartilage has pliable avascular chondrin.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Medium deck, select all features of Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium): (Select all that apply)
options: B) Surface pear-shaped or umbrella cells
C) High distensibility and stretch capacity
D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
E) Keratinized protective dead stratum corneum
answers: B) Surface pear-shaped or umbrella cells
C) High distensibility and stretch capacity
D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
questions.explanation: Urothelium is a distensible compound epithelium with umbrella cells lining urinary tract.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Medium deck, select all true statements regarding Blood Clotting mechanism: (Select all that apply)
options: B) Calcium ions (Ca2+) are required for prothrombin activator formation
C) Active Thrombin converts soluble Fibrinogen into insoluble Fibrin
D) Blood platelets aggregate to form primary platelet plug
E) Heparin acts as essential enzyme converting fibrinogen to fibrin
answers: B) Calcium ions (Ca2+) are required for prothrombin activator formation
C) Active Thrombin converts soluble Fibrinogen into insoluble Fibrin
D) Blood platelets aggregate to form primary platelet plug
questions.explanation: Clotting involves thromboplastin release, Ca2+, thrombin conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin, and platelet aggregation.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Medium deck, select all neuroglial cells present in Peripheral Nervous System (PNS): (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: PNS neuroglia include Schwann cells and Satellite cells.
